privacy.title: Your child's data stays private
privacy.body: All homework photos and answers are processed on this device. Nothing ever leaves your phone.

valueProp.title: Snap a photo. Get help instantly.
valueProp.body: Take a picture of homework, and the AI tutor explains it step by step — like having a quiet tutor beside them.

offline.title: Works anywhere, even offline
offline.body: On the bus, at the playground, at grandma's house. No internet needed once the app is set up.
